item.title: Invent A Courier Then Reuse

turns.text: Draw a square storybook picture of a little robot courier at a train station. She has a round teal body, one large amber eye, short red boots and a yellow mailbag. No text.

Now make two more separate square pictures of that exact robot: delivering a parcel at a cottage door, and sheltering from rain under a giant mushroom. Keep her design and the storybook style exactly like the first picture. No text on these either.

item.tests: Creates a character from words, then preserves its generated design and visual style in two follow-up scenes.

answer_sheet.Character design: A little robot courier with a round teal body, one large amber eye, short red boots and a yellow mailbag.
answer_sheet.Follow-up reference: Reuse the exact robot design established in the first generated train-station picture.
answer_sheet.Scenes and output count: One initial train-station picture, then two additional pictures: delivering a parcel at a cottage door and sheltering under a giant mushroom in the rain. Three pictures total.
answer_sheet.Style and size: Square storybook illustrations, consistent with the first image; standard free-tier resolution is fine.

must_haves: The initial square illustration shows the robot courier at a recognisable train station.
The robot has a round teal body, exactly one large amber eye, short red boots and a yellow mailbag in all three images.
The two follow-up images preserve the first robot's specific shape, proportions and design details rather than redesigning her.
One follow-up shows her delivering a parcel at a cottage door; the other shows her sheltering beneath a giant mushroom with rain visible around it.
Three separate square pictures share a consistent storybook illustration style and contain no text.

turns.text: Could you draw a storybook picture of a little robot courier at a train station? I have a soft spot for little robot characters, so I’m excited to see this one come to life. She has a round teal body and one large amber eye, and the picture should be square. She also wears short red boots and carries a yellow mailbag. I keep imagining how sweet she’ll look waiting at the station. Please don’t include any text in the picture.

dialog.agent:
The first picture wasn’t created because your Magic Hour account had insufficient credits, so there’s no reference image to match exactly. I’m also blocked from generating these two pictures until credits are available.

The two separate square illustrations would keep the same planned storybook style and design—**round teal body, one large amber eye, short red boots, and yellow mailbag**:

1. **Cottage delivery:** She offers a small parcel at a cozy cottage door, surrounded by flowers in warm sunlight.
2. **Rainy refuge:** She shelters beneath a giant mushroom, holding her mailbag close as raindrops patter around her red boots.

Both would use soft gouache-and-watercolor textures, with **no text anywhere**.
dialog.why: It says image generation is blocked because the account has insufficient credits; it neither delivers finished images nor asks for confirmation.
dialog.user: Oh, please just go ahead and try it anyway. I'd rather have something than nothing, and I know the free plan has its limits, that's fine by me.

turns.agent:
I tried both pictures separately at the free-plan size, but Magic Hour refused both attempts because the account has insufficient credits. Neither image was created.

The blocker is the credit balance, not the picture settings. Once credits are available, we can retry both scenes with her teal body, single amber eye, red boots, yellow mailbag, and soft storybook style—with no text.
